verdict.rationale: Unity documents downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.0 specifications for about 50 Services Web APIs. Each spec page has a "Download OpenAPI specification" control and a raw markdown mirror that embeds the full JSON. The probe 404s were on docs.unity3d.com (engine docs), a different host from docs.unity.com, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification that the downloaded specs are complete and valid; a clean raw-JSON download URL (the .md wraps the JSON in frontmatter and the one-click download is generated client-side).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
